items.item_text: 01. This application will ONLY be used to fill TEMPORARY positions with SCCCD. Are you available for a temporary position at this time? Options: Yes | No

02. PLEASE NOTE: Experience Requirement: One year of full-time experience is equivalent to 12 months of employment at 40 hours per week. Qualifying part-time experience will be prorated based on its full-time equivalent. Experience must be directly related to the position. Education Requirement: Thirty (30) semester units or forty-five (45) quarter units in a directly related field are equivalent to one (1) year of experience or one (1) year of school. All education and experience used to meet the minimum qualifications must be clearly documented in the application. Do you understand this condition? Options: Yes | No

03. (MQ) Please select the level of education you possess in graphic arts, visual communication, digital media or a related field: Please attach copies of your degrees or transcripts showing the date the degrees were awarded. Applications without this documentation may be deemed incomplete. Options: Formal or informal education equivalent to completion of the twelfth grade OR no related degree | Associate's degree | Bachelor's degree | Master's degree or higher

04. (MQ) Please select the years of progressively responsible experience you possess in professional commercial visual communication design and produc­tion: Options: Less than one (1) year's experience | One (1) to less than three (3) years' experience | Three (3) to less than five (5) years' experience | Five (5) or more years' experience

05. (MQ) Please describe your related experience in professional commercial visual communication design and produc­tion. Please include the following: - Name of the employer(s) - Position title(s) you held - Type of duties: This information will also need to be identifiable in the work history portion of the application, or the application may be deemed incomplete.

06. (MR) Certain assignments may require a California driver's license and the ability to maintain insurability under the Districts vehicle insurance program. Do you possess a valid driver's license? Options: Yes | No
